video.title: Fantasy Basketball Mock Draft Pick 7 - Cade Cunningham Build

summary: Josh Lloyd runs a 12-team, 9-category mock draft from pick 7 and takes Cade Cunningham in the first round. He thinks Cade belongs around picks 6 or 7, not 5, because of last season's free throw percentage, his turnovers, and a possible drop in efficiency. His argument for the middle rounds is that players in the same tier are so close in value that drafts are won by avoiding bad reaches and hitting on high-upside picks late. He comments on reaches and slides throughout, plus news on the Warriors' starting lineup, Sacramento's injured centers and Haliburton's preseason. His team ends up guard-heavy and weak in big man stats, but it projects second in the league.
